post.description:
"Chấm lại": grade a submitted answer that has no grade yet; a graded one is returned as it
is, never paid for twice.

Save the last text and submit (nothing typed after the last draft save is lost), commit,
then grade. Submitting again, or from a second tab, grades what was submitted first.
End every session of the user, this one included (ADR-0020 §3).
Email a one-hour reset link if the account exists; the same answer either way (AC5).

the email counts as verified. Done in the request's transaction, with the token's use.

get.description:
One document with its processing status (T4.9). Errors: 404 `document_not_found`
(another user's too).

patch.description:
Rename a document (`short_name`, US-01 AC7) or change its `role` (T7.4). Errors: 404
`document_not_found` (another user's too); 422 `nothing_to_change`, `invalid_short_name`;
409 `short_name_taken` (another document of the subject has it: pick another) or
`document_not_ready` (role `textbook` on a document not read) or
`textbook_exists` (the subject already has a main textbook: replace it with
`PUT /v1/subjects/{id}/textbook`, nothing is overwritten here).

post.description:
The file is stored: check it, mark the document uploaded and announce it to ai-service
(`document.uploaded.v1`, in the same transaction). Confirming again changes nothing.

Errors: 404 `document_not_found` (another user's too) or `subject_not_found` (deleted since);
409 `upload_incomplete` (nothing stored yet: upload, or ask for a new URL, then confirm);
422 `size_mismatch` or `content_mismatch`: the file is deleted and the document stays
refused, so the same file cannot be uploaded again; 503 `storage_unavailable`.

Locks the subject FOR SHARE, then the document FOR UPDATE: the order `reserve` takes them.
Limited per account (429): each confirm calls the store.

422.description: The file stored is not the PDF declared

get.description:
The table of contents of an indexed document (US-02 AC2), read from its derived file.

Errors: 404 `document_not_found` (another user's too); 409 `not_indexed`; 502 `toc_invalid`
(the file is not JSON or too large); 503 `storage_unavailable`.

post.description:
Đưa vào luyện tập: the question becomes a practice question (its schedule starts at the
first attempt, T8.3). Keeping twice keeps the first time.

Không giữ: retired and marked rejected; its text stays in the duplicate checks, so it is
never suggested again. A kept question is removed by `worthless`, not here.

get.description: The attempt as the screen shows it (after a reload too). Never grades.

post.description:
"Chấm lại": grade a submitted answer that has no grade yet; a graded one is returned as it
is, never paid for (or scheduled) twice.

Save the last text, submit with the timing, commit; then grade. Submitting again, or from
a second tab, grades what was submitted first and keeps its timing.
"Chấm sai": append a user grade; the practice schedule is rebuilt from `practice_log`.

Serve a question: its open draft (made if there is none, with the server's `served_at`).
A bank question with no answer gets an AI-drafted one now, once, so it is ready (AC13).
"Câu này vô giá trị": never asked again and its schedule stops; its log stays.

The draft of the current question, made on first call. The server picks the question:
a client cannot open an attempt on a question outside the session.

schema.title: Response Current Question V1 Review Sessions  Session Id  Current Get

post.description:
Close the session: "completed" when every question it can still ask is answered, else
"user_stopped". The session is locked first, so a submit in flight is counted (plan D14).
Stopping again changes nothing and answers the same.

patch.description:
Change a section's page range, `excluded` or `studied` (US-13 AC4). Errors: 404
`section_not_found` (another user's too); 422 `nothing_to_change`, `invalid_range`
(`0 < start <= end`, both ends or neither), `outside_document`, `outside_parent`,
`children_outside`.

post.description:
Confirm the card: write the session's ranges, notes and dates and announce it to
ai-service (`session.confirmed.v1`), all in one transaction. Confirming again returns the
session as it was saved and announces nothing more.

Errors: 404 `session_not_found` (another user's too), `subject_not_found` (deleted since),
`document_not_found` (another subject's or user's too); 409 `not_indexed`, `upload_incomplete`;
422 `bad_range`, `bad_date`, `bad_note`, `size_mismatch`, `content_mismatch`; 429 with
Retry-After (each confirm calls the store once per note, R60a); 503 `storage_unavailable`.

Locks the subject FOR SHARE, then the session FOR UPDATE (the order `create_draft` and a
subject's delete agree on).

409.description: upload_incomplete (a note not stored yet), not_indexed or submission_exists

422.description: bad_range, bad_date, bad_note, size_mismatch or content_mismatch

post.description:
A URL to upload one note file of a draft session (201), or a fresh one for a file asked
before (200).

Errors: 404 `session_not_found` (another user's too); 409 `session_confirmed`,
`too_many_notes`, `storage_quota_exceeded`; 422 `file_too_large`, `bad_note` (the same file
asked with another type or size); 429 with Retry-After; 503 when a dependency is down.

200.description: A fresh URL for a file asked before

get.description:
Where processing of a confirmed session stands, read from the server (T4.18, US-02 AC11).

Errors: 403 for an unverified account; 404 `session_not_found` for another user's session and
for a draft (nothing is processed before the confirm).

404.description: session_not_found (another user's, or still a draft)

schema.title: Response List Subjects V1 Subjects Get

delete.description:
Soft-delete a subject with no review history (us-01 AC8, T2.3b). Its exam, questions and
units stay but are hidden; the name can be used again. A subject with an attempt, a draft
included, answers 409 (deleting those comes with T6.3).

get.description:
The subject's documents, oldest first (T4.9). Errors: 404 `subject_not_found` (another
user's too).

schema.title: Response List Documents V1 Subjects  Subject Id  Documents Get

post.description:
A URL to upload one PDF to the subject (201), or the document it already is (200).

The same file (SHA-256) again: uploaded → `duplicate: true` and no URL; still uploading →
a fresh URL for the same document. Errors: 404 `subject_not_found`; 422
`unsupported_file_type`, `invalid_filename`, `file_too_large`, `size_mismatch` (the same
file asked with another size), `content_mismatch` (the same file was refused before); 409
`storage_quota_exceeded`; 429 with Retry-After; 503 `storage_full` or when a dependency is
down.

200.description: The file is already in the subject

schema.title: Response Waiting Candidates V1 Subjects  Subject Id  Generated Questions Get

get.description:
The outline of the subject's main textbook. Errors: 404 `subject_not_found` (another
user's too).

schema.title: Response List Practice Types V1 Subjects  Subject Id  Practice Types Get

post.description:
Save the sentence as a draft and return the card to confirm (US-02 AC3-AC5, AC11).

Never a 5xx for the AI: no answer, over the budget, hard cap or an answer that does not fit
the subject's documents all give `card: "manual"`. Errors: 404 `subject_not_found`; 429 with
Retry-After (each call may cost AI money).
An empty draft session to upload this submission's files to. Calls no AI.

404.description: subject_not_found, or the feature is off

put.description:
Set or change the subject's main textbook (US-01 AC5). The old one becomes `auxiliary`;
nothing is deleted. Errors: 404 `subject_not_found`, `document_not_found` (another subject's
or user's too); 409 `document_not_ready` (not uploaded, refused or failed), or
`textbook_has_cards` with `cards`: live cards are linked to the current textbook, send
`confirm: true` after the learner has agreed.

409.description: The textbook has cards linked to it; confirm to change it

post.description:
Store the submission and queue it for ai-service. Submitting a session again returns the
first submission and announces nothing more.

Errors: 404 `session_not_found`, `document_not_found`; 409 `session_confirmed`,
`upload_incomplete`, `storage_quota_exceeded`; 422 a mention error (`detail` is an object
with `code`, `mention`, `part`, `candidates`), `nothing_submitted`, `text_too_long`,
`bad_note`, `size_mismatch`, `content_mismatch`; 429; 503 `storage_unavailable`.

422.description: A mention that does not resolve (`detail` names the part), nothing handed in, text_too_long, bad_note, size_mismatch or content_mismatch

delete.description:
Undo a skip; 204 whether or not the unit was skipped. Nothing is added to or taken from an
open session here: a question hidden by the skip is asked again, and the session cap (20)
hides the last replacement, if any (`progress`).
